name: ingeniux-cms-companion-extension
description: A browser companion for Ingeniux CMS with live-site navigation, view controls and useful CMS shortcuts.

scripts.zip: node -e "const v=process.env.npm_package_version; const name='ingeniux-cms-companion-extension-v'+v; require('child_process').execSync(\`ln -s dist \${name} && zip -r \${name}.zip \${name} -x '*.DS_Store' && rm \${name}\`, {stdio: 'inherit'});"
scripts.release: node -e "const v=process.env.npm_package_version; require('child_process').execSync(\`gh release create v\${v} ./ingeniux-cms-companion-extension-v\${v}.zip --title \"Release v\${v}\"\`, {stdio: 'inherit'});"
